# Rare Legacy Life Group

> Licensed life insurance and annuity agency at 59 W. Germantown Pike, East Norriton, PA 19403 (Montgomery County). Phone (484) 430-4363. Serves clients in 49 U.S. states (excluding California). Offers free life insurance quotes (term, whole life, mortgage protection, final expense, key person) and complimentary Retirement Income Blueprint reviews covering Social Security timing, pensions, savings, and annuities.

Advisors: Daniel Pennachietti (NPN 21395664, Life and Fixed Annuities); Christian Pennachietti (NPN 21707801, Series 6, Series 63, SIE, Life, Variable and Fixed Annuities).
